title.zh: 歡迎來到量子計算實驗室

description.en: Quantum Lab was established in 2020 at Department of Computer Science, National Tsing Hua University, Taiwan. Our research areas include quantum complexity, pseudorandom unitary, quantum optimization, and post quantum crytography.
description.zh: 量子計算實驗室成立於 2020 年，隸屬於國立清華大學資訊工程學系。研究領域涵蓋量子複雜度、偽隨機酉矩陣、量子最佳化以及後量子密碼學。
